data.title: The preview that still needed a date
data.goal: The preview that still needed a date
data.situation:
At the publication desk, Nora opened the website preview. A short profile introduced the volunteer whose voice appeared in the programme. The visuals showed the side gate and the room upstairs, rather than a general photograph of the library. Jo checked that every timetable was up-to-date. The next publication would go to the printer the following morning, but one activity still lacked a definite starting time. They marked it as awaiting confirmation instead of filling the space. Nora clicked through the page as a new reader might. When a caption pointed to the wrong doorway, Jo corrected it before sending the file. A familiar image could mislead as easily as a familiar word. Jo: Is there a definite time for the last activity?
Nora: Not yet. Keep that clear in the preview.
Jo: I have updated the visuals and the timetable.

readingBlocks.zh: 发布台上，诺拉打开网站预览页。人物简介介绍了节目里发言的志愿者。配图展示侧门和楼上的房间，没有只放一张图书馆全景。乔逐项确认时间表是最新的。下一份刊物明早送印，不过有一项活动仍缺确切开始时间。她们注明待确认，没有自行填写。诺拉像新读者一样逐页查看，发现一条图注指错门口，乔在送出文件前改正。熟悉的图片和熟悉的词一样，也可能误导人。

诺拉：还没有，在预览页里讲清楚。
乔：我更新了图片和时间表。
